subject: Archaeology
title: The Ancestral Puebloans: Cliff Dwellers Who Left
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Ancestral Puebloans: Cliff Dwellers Who Left.

hook.text: The Ancestral Puebloans built stunning cliff dwellings at Mesa Verde — then abandoned them all around 1300 CE and never.

buildup.text: Their cliff palaces had hundreds of rooms, towers, and kivas carved into sandstone overhangs in the American Southwest.

discovery.text: Tree-ring data shows a severe drought hit the region from 1276 to 1299 — the Great Drought devastated agriculture.

twist.text: Drought was not the only factor. Evidence of warfare, burned villages, and even cannibalism suggests social collapse.

climax.text: They did not vanish — they migrated south and became today's Pueblo peoples: Hopi, Zuni, and Rio Grande communities.

punchline.text: They were not lost. They left a home that could no longer feed them.

quiz.question: What happened to the Ancestral Puebloans of Mesa Verde?
options: They were wiped out by European diseases before Columbus arrived
They migrated south and became today's Pueblo peoples: Hopi, Zuni, and others
They moved into underground cities that have never been found
